title: Listing Photo Quality & Room Classification

blueprintSignals.name: Room class probability
blueprintSignals.definition: softmax output of the vision model for each room type
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Rare rooms such as utility or study are under-represented, so check per-class recall

blueprintSignals.name: Blur score
blueprintSignals.definition: variance of the Laplacian of the grey image
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Depends on image size, so compute at a fixed resolution

blueprintSignals.name: Exposure histogram
blueprintSignals.definition: share of pixels clipped in highlights and in shadows
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: High-dynamic-range photos look clipped but are fine, so condition on the scene type

blueprintSignals.name: Duplicate similarity
blueprintSignals.definition: perceptual hash distance to other photos in the same listing
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Crops and filters change the hash, so use an embedding distance as a second check

engineFeatures.meaning: how strongly a region stands out from its neighbourhood
the strongest local contrast anywhere in the image

label: For "Listing Photo Quality & Room Classification": Classify the room type and quality of each listing photo so galleries are ordered well and poor images are flagged to the agent. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training mostly on professional photos hides failures on the phone pictures that most agents upload.
